note: generated by tools/probe_sway.py from extracted/probe/rec_*.csv (UE4SS recordings of the real game)

move_input.note: InputValue is ~+-1 whenever walking/sprinting/crouch-walking (saturates by ~0.5 m/s)

roll.model: roll = FInterp(speed)[ strafe_gain*5*move_x + look_gain*map(Yaw(DeltaTime), -3..3 -> 8..-8) ]  (UE deg, cw+)

lean.conclusion: Leaning Alpha FInterp 12 (BP) -> FInterp 8 = NormalizedLean and camera offset; roll = one more FInterp 2

ads.is_aiming_latency: IsAiming flips on the key frame; node AdsScale pins switch the same frame (no ramp)

sway_node_pins.note: aim pin = table AdsScale (3, 2 for M4A1 pos y/z) * MagnifiedADSScale; hip pin = MagnifiedADSScale

gun.frame: ik_hand_gun origin/orientation in the FP_Camera socket frame (X fwd, Y right, Z up, cm; rotation UE roll/pitch/yaw deg), relative to the first 40 frames of the recording

look.model: x = spring(omega, zeta = zeta_per_damping * SpringDamping) of clamp(input,10) * Scale * gain, rotation about the gun origin; SpringStiffness / SpringSpeed / SmoothDamping did not change the response (free omega 9-10.5 on stiffness .7-1, speed 7-10)
look.sign_note: sign of the gun delta per +1 of LookDeltaInput.X (yaw, + = turn right) / .Y (pitch, + = look up); rot_pitch is UE pitch (+ = nose up)

move.model: pos_y = -gain * Scale * FInterp(DampingSpeed = table SmoothDamping)(strafe axis +-1, + = right); the spring / SpringSmoothingSpeed stage is transparent at this resolution

ads.note: alpha = sinusoidal(raw), raw moves linearly at AdsSpeed pin * sin_speed_over_pin: the gun origin reaches the ADS pose in ~0.35 s (the pin alone would give 0.43 s); BAS AimIn/AimOut additives are not played
